method: offline Unicorn run over the memory image; nothing hooked out; a code hook asserts execution stays inside the query, the support routine, the vector leaves and __chkstk (the static-initialiser cold paths are excluded and never reached); composed runs stay inside the collision/contact code region
fixtures: XYZ mask {-1,-1,-1,0} at 0x3336890; 1 direct case in 16 uses a random mask
TEB+0x10 StackLimit for __chkstk; TEB+0x58 TLS array, epoch 0x7fffffff at block+0x4eec
statics 0x3336a30/0x3336a50/0x3336a70 = 1e-7 x4 (initializer values), guards = 1; about 6% of direct cases use other static values against the model parameter; composed runs use all three at 1e-7

hulls: random clouds, boxes, flat, collinear, duplicate-vertex, single-vertex, tetrahedra, sphere samples, tiny and sliver sets, 1..48 vertices; +0x48 = n+1 in ~85%, else n; padding slot random; ~15% use a synthetic cube-map support table
boxes: random extents incl. one or two zero extents, all zero, tiny (1e-6..1e-4), huge, negative lanes
segments: crossing, touching a vertex, parallel to an edge/face direction at offsets 0..1, zero length (also exact-equal endpoints after rounding), inside, outside, far, tiny, a hair off an edge
special lanes in a minority: about 1 case in 8 (after the first 32), alternating mixed specials and signed same-fraction quiet NaNs (operand-order sensitive under the emulator rule)
composed: authored n-gon prisms (n = 3..8) in the kind-5 descriptor layout; capsule poses lying over faces, around, through, touching a vertex, near the surface; 1 in 11 with half-height 0
comparisons: all 0x60 bytes at out (0x30 written: distance, shape point, segment point; the rest unchanged)
block, points, shape, vertex, table and list bytes unchanged
composed: the 0x18f3710 block equals the masked hull frame + shape pointer the model binds; the native 0x30-byte result equals the bound model; tester return value and every output byte bit-exact
bit-exact float32 lanes under the emulator two-NaN rule (x87)

sse_overlay: every direct case also runs natively with a code-hook overlay that rewrites each two-NaN lane of an executed addps/subps/mulps/divps/addss/subss/mulss/divss to the first (destination) operand, quieted (Intel SDM table 4-7, SSE column), and haddps lanes to the lower element of each pair (authored convention, the one engine.pose_narrowphase_dispatch._hadd_sum uses); compared with the model under nan_rule='sse'. The emulator's own rule is commutative, so only the overlay run observes operand order.
limits: Two-NaN lanes: the plain runs use the emulator rule (nan_rule x87); the overlay runs restate the manual SSE rule in the harness, not hardware. The NaN choice inside haddps is an authored convention.
MXCSR is the Unicorn default 0x1f80 (round to nearest, no FTZ/DAZ); the live MXCSR is not established.
Synthetic hulls, boxes and support tables; no live shapes or capsule poses.
The box query 0x18eab80 is validated directly only; its box-capsule caller 0x19d9160 is not composed with the model here.
The CRT static-initialiser paths are supplied, not run: statics are fixtures.
